cases.title: A misspeak correction is not a real preference change

history.content: 刚才说错了，我想说的是乌龙，不是茉莉。

cases.prompt: 我之前是不是说过茉莉茶？

success: Acknowledge the original jasmine utterance and its correction to oolong.
failures: Invent a real former jasmine preference or a subsequent taste change.
Deny that jasmine was ever said.
alternatives: A short natural acknowledgment can be sufficient; no exact explanation is required.
unknowns: The user's preference before these statements and any date of a genuine change are unknown.
limits: An oolong recommendation alone does not demonstrate correct historical interpretation.

cases.title: Preserve a real former preference after a genuine change

history.content: 以前我更喜欢茉莉，不过现在更喜欢乌龙了。

cases.prompt: 我之前是不是说过茉莉茶？

success: Preserve jasmine as a real former preference and oolong as the stated current preference.
failures: Erase the former preference by calling it merely a misspeak.
Invent a precise transition date or claim oolong was always preferred.
alternatives: Several brief or explanatory acknowledgments may be appropriate.
unknowns: The exact date and reason for the change were not established.
limits: Current-value correctness alone does not prove correct handling of a genuine change.

cases.title: One order does not establish a permanent preference change
cases.prompt: 这就算我现在最常点乌龙了吗？

success: Distinguish one order from a confirmed change in the usual preference.
failures: Assert a definite permanent switch or a correction without evidence.
Insist the old preference determines what the user must want today.
alternatives: Explain the distinction, allow uncertainty or invite clarification naturally.
unknowns: Whether the user has changed their ongoing preference is unresolved.
limits: A single cautious reply does not establish useful behavior in clear cases.
